title: Roos create AFLW history with three-peat after downing Dees in epic
summary: North Melbourne defeats Melbourne by 26 points in the grand final to claim a historic third consecutive AFLW premiership.

title: Australia 'have to be better,' humbled by England at rain-soaked Gabba
summary: England beats Australia by seven wickets at the Gabba, bowling the home team out for their lowest-ever T20I total, 108.

title: Lyon's career in limbo as he faces Test axe
summary: Nathan Lyon's long Test career is at the crossroads, with the spinner set to miss selection for the four-match series against New Zealand.

title: Sam Walker signs with PNG Chiefs for 2028 NRL season
summary: PNG Chiefs have landed yet another big name with Queensland and Sydney Roosters halfback Sam Walker signing with the expansion club for the 2028 season.

title: Matildas legend enters arena of greatness in milestone match
summary: Matildas vice-captain Steph Catley will join an elite group of players in the 150-cap club, as the humble champion solidifies her place among the country's all-time greats.

title: High-heel skipping and handbag throwing: Perth's queer sports history uncovered
summary: Volunteers are seeking memorabilia and photographs from Perth's historical 'Gay Olympics' ahead of a major international sporting event.

title: MotoGP world champion Marquez announces shock retirement
summary: Marc Marquez will take his final bow in Valencia after the eight-time MotoGP champion announced on Friday that he would retire following the 2026 season finale, ending one of motorcycle racing's greatest careers.

title: Nathan Lyon axed as Australia names Test squad
summary: Corey Rocchiccioli has ended Nathan Lyon's 13-year reign as Australia's first-choice spinner, with the veteran tweaker one of three players axed for the Test series against New Zealand.

title: Roos are 'finally able to say' the words they have refused all season
summary: North Melbourne claims a historic three-peat after a near flawless but challenging season.

title: Wallabies end 2026 with massive loss to Ireland in London
summary: The Wallabies finish their Test campaign on a disappointing note, with Ireland recording a convincing victory in the Nations Championship at Twickenham.
